title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am an Engineer working in MNC company. I wanted to know how to save TAX, as the amount of TAX that is deducted is increasing day by day. Please help me and other muslims as well who as struct here and much money of muslims are wasted in TAX. 1890 views Q. طبی تجربہ کے لیے منڈک کو مارنا 3718 views Q. اقتصادیات سے متعلق اکثر مضامین میں سودی طریقے سکھائے جاتے ہیں، تو کیاا قتصادیات کے مضامین (جیسے بونڈ، اسٹاک، سود کے ساتھ)اکاؤنٹنگ(حساب و کتاب) پڑھا نا جائزہے؟اور کیا ایسے مضامین پڑھا کر حاصل ہونے والی آمدنی حلال ہے یا نہیں؟ 1352 views Q. We take 10 lakh loan from bank and made a house on it. 1973 views Q. During my tenure with an organization I happened to get some money which I later found out was Haraam. What i did is that when i was absent i would get my attendance signed for me by my friend and thus prevent any deductions being made from my salary on account of leave. Later I found that this money is not halaal for me. So I havent used that money and kept it aside. Please guide me as to what I should do with that money. I asked a local mufti and he said that I should return the money anyhow to the company. But I am not sure how can this be done. As I no longer work for the company, I am in a big dilemma with this money. Please guide me on this issue and what should be done with the money. I really want to get rid of this money as early as possible and in the most shariah compliant way Jazakallah. 1553 views Q. aslkm, janab mujhe ek sahab ne kaha ki unko unke haakim yani boss namaaz ke waqt kaam de deten hain to wo namaaz nahin pad pate..aur wo kehne lage ki agar haakim mana karta hai naamaz ke liya to mafi hai.janab private naukri main aksar aise waqiyat samne ate rehte hain,QURAN AUR HADEES ki roshni main batayein. 2148 views Q. i am a doctor.i want to ask if i marry a doctor & she wish to get post graduation in obstetrics&gynecology,1.should i allow her or not as i know situation is very bad in medical colleges?2.should i allow her to work in any hospital?3.what about the salary she earn?can i use it or its upto her?because she may wish to give it to her parents?please guide me.Jazakallahu khairan. 2150 views Q. I know we are forbidden to hang pictures of human and animals on the walls in our house but what if we keep them on our digital cameras or our computers or our mobile phones? 3720 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 24530 Country: India Title: I have a bulding (complex) now a nationalaise bank BANK OF INDIA want to open his branch in my permises on rent is that right or wrong to gine my permises to indian govt. bank on rent of 25000/- per month please clear me in detail Question: as slamu alaikum i have a bulding (complex) now a nationalaise bank BANK OF INDIA want to open his branch in my permises on rent is that right or wrong to gine my permises to indian govt. bank on rent of 25000/- per month please clear me in detail Answer ID: 24530 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1653/1211/H=1431) It is allowable, as it is mentioned in Fatawa Khalilia. However, it is better not to give. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
